representation_gate_rule: No strategic R7.5.4 runner may start unless the durable R7.5.3 result exists, r7_5_3_representation_ablation_pass=true and selected_candidate is one of C0..C5.
ten_action_generalization_rule: The accepted six-action uncertainty-damping algebra, bootstrap behavior, regret matching, ensemble disagreement computation, epsilon scaling/capping and probability normalization must be generalized only by replacing the action dimension 6 with 10 and by using the state-local deduplicated universal legal mask. No coefficient, threshold or mixture rule may change.
mandatory_semantic_regression_before_act: A dedicated regression must compare the accepted six-action uncertainty implementation with the ten-action generalization on embedded six-action fixtures (actions 6..9 permanently illegal/zero) and require probability/statistic equality to <=1e-12 before any strategic action runner is authorized.

cfr_execution.scenario_cycle: exact R7.4 TRUE_HEADS_UP / THREE_HANDED scenario cycles
cfr_execution.bootstrap_iteration_1_behavior: uniform over state-local effective universal legal actions
cfr_execution.iterations_2_to_5_behavior: frozen accepted uncertainty-damped four-member advantage ensemble generalized to ten actions

advantage_fit.side_member_memory: same frozen advantage reservoir state as primary at that iteration
advantage_fit.side_member_seed_rule: Must reuse the accepted R7.3 ensemble member initialization/batch seed derivation semantics from the pinned base_ensemble_runner object. If direct reuse is impossible because of model type, a mechanically equivalent helper must be frozen and regression-proven before execution; no seed may be selected from results.

average_policy_fit.reason: Different action abstractions induce different strategic trajectories; fairness is enforced by identical chance/training seeds, root budgets, algorithm and compute steps, not by forcing an impossible shared on-policy strategy reservoir.

candidate_pairing.exception: Only survivors selected by the precommitted 160->320->640 cascade advance to the next full fresh level; every survivor at that level receives the same full level budget.

runtime.thread_override_policy: A single explicit thread contract must be frozen in the runner workflow and applied identically to every candidate.
